processDetail: Tell KKE the property type, size, location and preferred schedule.
KKE reviews the details you sent.
You receive a scope and quotation for your site.
Cleaning begins on the agreed schedule.

faqs.q: What site details should I prepare?
faqs.a: Share the property type, approximate size, location, preferred schedule, target date and any access or specialist requirements.
Pricing depends on the size of the site and the scope of work. Send the site details and KKE will prepare a quotation for your property.
Yes. KKE supports one-off work as well as daily, weekly, monthly and long-term site contracts.
